# Project Constitution

1. Keep all new screens mobile-first and cross-platform.
2. Preserve the existing Express API routes, payloads, response fields, and authentication contract.
3. Keep credentials and database configuration out of client code and generated artifacts.
4. Preserve loading, empty, validation, and error states from the reference client.
5. Keep login and registration behavior unchanged.
6. Prefer existing Expo/React Native dependencies and project conventions.
